name: vllm_topk_softmax
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench vLLM test_topk_softmax.py. Computes softmax over gating_output (num_tokens, num_experts) then selects top-k; reference allocates the topk_weights/topk_ids/token_expert_indices output buffers, calls vLLM _custom_ops.topk_softmax in-place, and returns only (topk_weights, topk_ids). token_expert_indices is an internal scratch buffer that the test explicitly does not validate, so it is deliberately not returned; the default comparison then checks exactly what the test asserts (fp32 weights via assert_close, int32 ids exact). top_k (1/2/4) and renormalize (False/True) vary per workload line and top_k<=num_experts always holds. Requires vLLM at eval time.
